items.text: Teachers moving to corporate training or business roles already hold strong skills in explaining, managing groups, planning and giving feedback, and the move works best when you translate classroom results into business language and close gaps in tools, commercial awareness and corporate norms.
Translate your skills, choose a target role such as trainer, learning designer, customer success or operations, and show a sample training with results.
Read your contract and ask about variable pay in the new role.
